generation_parents.algorithm: Score each candidate by a normalized angular/radial "sweep-sector" priority: combine the polar angle of the candidate around the depot with a radial-distance term and a capacity-fill term, so the route follows a rotational sweep pattern rather than pairwise savings, then pick the feasible node with the smallest sweep score.
